source_text: Finis Libri Quarti et commentarii in Canticum superstitis (20/20). Homiliae Hieronymi in Canticum et Prologus Rufini atque Libri I–III antea digesta. Hactenus a Surge, veni usque ad Capite vulpes pusillas, Domino adiuvante, digessimus. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: End of-Book Fourth and of-commentary on Song surviving (20/20). Homilies of-Jerome on Song and Prologue of-Rufinus and Books I–III before set-in-order. Thus-far from Rise, come as-far-as to Catch foxes little, Lord helping, we-have-set-in-order. Amen.
pass_b_english: End of the Fourth Book and of the surviving commentary on the Song (20/20). Jerome’s Homilies on the Song and Rufinus’s Prologue and Books I–III were set in order before. Thus far, from Arise, come through Catch us the little foxes, with the Lord’s help, we have set in order. Amen.
notes: Liber IV 20/20 CLOSEOUT; Rufinus Comm. Cant. surviving end.
